results.market_title: Will the highest temperature in Ankara be 29°C on September 1?
results.reasoning: Multiple forecast sources (Yandex, weather-forecast.com, climate normals) converge on a high temperature near 28–29°C for Ankara on Sep 1, 2026, with historical climate averages pegging the seasonal normal high at exactly 29.2°C for that date. Since forecasts split between 28°C and 29°C and the resolution requires an exact whole-degree NOAA reading at Esenboğa, 29°C is one of the two most likely single-degree buckets but not a lock given typical day-ahead forecast uncertainty of ±1-2°C.
